label: prop:hecke-mass-trace
title: Mass via the Markov trace of the Hecke mass element
html:
Proposition. Mass via the Markov trace of the Hecke mass element

Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a QOU, let \varrho \colon \mathbf{1} \to A be a vortex with braid representative \beta \in B_n, and let \Phi_{\mathrm{mass}}(\beta) \in H_n(R, q) be its Hecke mass element (Hecke mass element).

Proposition. The categorical mass (mass identity) equals the norm of the Markov trace of the Hecke mass element:

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho_\beta)
  \;=\;
  \bigl\lvert
    \mathrm{tr}_M\!\bigl(\Phi_{\mathrm{mass}}(\beta)\bigr)
  \bigr\rvert.

Moreover, the topological decomposition (topological mass) descends to H_n(R, q):

  \mathrm{tr}_M\!\bigl(\Phi_{\mathrm{mass}}(\beta)\bigr)
  \;=\;
  \mathrm{tr}_M\!\bigl(\Phi^{\mathrm{desc}}(\beta)\bigr)
  \;+\;
  \sum_{i=1}^{N}
  \mathrm{tr}_M\!\bigl(\Phi^{\mathrm{trans}}_i(\beta)\bigr).

Archimedean specialisation. The categorical mass-squared, the hyperbolic volume \mathrm{vol} : \mathbb{R} and \hbar : \mathbb{R}, and the descended trace are the archimedean (\mathbb{R}-valued) readouts of the generic Markov-trace mass data; the R\to\mathbb{R} realisation is acknowledged here.
